import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from collections import Counter
import re

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)


def load_data():
    """Load training and test data"""
    train = pd.read_csv("input/ru_train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("input/ru_test_2.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")
    return train, test, sample_sub


def create_token_features(train_df):
    """Create features for each token"""
    # Build vocabulary and encode tokens
    vocab_train = {}
    vocab_counter = 0

    def get_vocab_item(text):
        if pd.isna(text):
            return "__unknown__"
        return str(text)

    # Extract features from training data
    train_features = []
    train_labels = []

    for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
        # Encode the before token
        before = get_vocab_item(row["before"])
        vocab_item = before if before in vocab_train else before
        if before not in vocab_train:
            vocab_train[before] = vocab_counter
            vocab_counter += 1

        train_features.append(vocab_train[before])
        train_labels.append(row["after"])

    # Also track class distribution for test data prediction
    class_counts = train_df["class"].value_counts(normalize=True).to_dict()
    return train_features, train_labels, vocab_counter, class_counts


def simple_text_normalizer(train_df, test_df, sample_sub):
    """Simple token-level text normalization model"""

    # Build lookup tables
    after_vocabulary = {}
    vocab_counter = 0

    # Map before tokens to after tokens
    before_to_after = {}
    after_to_vocab = {}

    for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
        before = row["before"]
        after = row["after"]

        # Handle nulls
        if pd.isna(before):
            before = "__null__"
        if pd.isna(after):
            after = "__null__"

        if before not in before_to_after:
            before_to_after[before] = after

        # Create vocabulary if not exists
        if after not in after_to_vocab:
            after_to_vocab[after] = vocab_counter
            vocab_counter += 1

    # Create vocabulary for training
    vocab = list(after_to_vocab.keys())

    # Create prediction map for test data
    test_preds = {}

    # Merge test with sample submission to get correct format
    for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():
        token_id = row["sentence_id"]
        token_idx = row["token_id"]
        id_key = f"{token_id}_{token_idx}"

        before = row["before"]

        # Handle nulls
        if pd.isna(before):
            before = "__null__"

        # Get predicted after from training data
        if before in before_to_after:
            pred_after = before_to_after[before]
        else:
            # For unknown tokens, use the token itself (identity)
            pred_after = str(before)

        test_preds[id_key] = pred_after

    # Build submission
    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": sample_sub["id"].reset_index(drop=True),
            "after": [test_preds.get(sid, sid) for sid in sample_sub["id"]],
        }
    )

    return submission


def main():

    train, test, sample_sub = load_data()
    print(f"Training samples: {len(train)}")
    print(f"Test samples: {len(test)}")
    print(f"Sample submission rows: {len(sample_sub)}")

    print("\nAnalyzing class distribution...")
    print(train["class"].value_counts().head(10))

    print("\nAnalyzing before token distribution...")
    print(train["before"].value_counts().head(20))

    print("\nAnalyzing after token distribution...")
    print(train["after"].value_counts().head(20))

    print("\nBuilding normalization model...")

    # Create feature mappings
    before_to_after = {}
    before_counts = train["before"].value_counts(normalize=True)

    # Build direct mapping from training data
    for _, row in train.iterrows():
        before = row["before"]
        if pd.isna(before):
            before = "__null__"
        if before not in before_to_after:
            before_to_after[before] = row["after"]

    # Also create reverse mapping for validation
    after_vocab = set()
    for _, row in train.iterrows():
        if pd.isna(row["after"]):
            after_vocab.add("__null__")
        else:
            after_vocab.add(row["after"])

    print(f"\nTotal unique 'before' tokens: {len(train['before'].unique())}")
    print(f"Total unique 'after' tokens: {len(train['after'].unique())}")
    print(f"Total training samples: {len(train)}")

    # Create test predictions
    print("\nGenerating predictions for test set...")

    # Get the set of all IDs from sample submission
    test_ids = sample_sub["id"].values

    predictions = {}

    # Build test ID to before token mapping
    test_before_map = {}
    for _, row in test.iterrows():
        token_id = row["sentence_id"]
        token_idx = row["token_id"]
        id_key = f"{token_id}_{token_idx}"
        before = row["before"]
        test_before_map[id_key] = before if not pd.isna(before) else "__null__"

    # Generate predictions
    for id_key, before in test_before_map.items():
        if before in before_to_after:
            predictions[id_key] = before_to_after[before]
        else:
            # For unseen tokens, keep original (identity normalization)
            predictions[id_key] = str(before) if not pd.isna(before) else "__null__"

    # Create submission
    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": sample_sub["id"].reset_index(drop=True),
            "after": [predictions.get(sid, sid) for sid in sample_sub["id"]],
        }
    )

    # Save submission
    print("\nSaving submission to submission/submission.csv...")
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
    submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved with {len(submission)} rows")

    # Calculate validation metric using training data split
    print("\nCalculating accuracy metric on hold-out validation set...")

    # Split training data for validation
    split_idx = int(len(train) * 0.1)
    val_df = train.head(split_idx)
    train_df = train[split_idx:]

    # Build validation model from training portion
    train_before_to_after = {}
    for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
        before = str(row["before"]) if not pd.isna(row["before"]) else "__null__"
        after = str(row["after"]) if not pd.isna(row["after"]) else "__null__"
        if before not in train_before_to_after:
            train_before_to_after[before] = after

    # Calculate accuracy on validation portion
    val_predictions = []
    val_actuals = []

    for _, row in val_df.iterrows():
        before = str(row["before"]) if not pd.isna(row["before"]) else "__null__"
        after = str(row["after"]) if not pd.isna(row["after"]) else "__null__"

        pred = train_before_to_after.get(before, before)
        val_predictions.append(pred)
        val_actuals.append(after)

    # Calculate accuracy
    correct = sum(1 for p, a in zip(val_predictions, val_actuals) if p == a)
    accuracy = correct / len(val_actuals)

    print(f"\nValidation accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")
    print(f"Correct predictions: {correct}/{len(val_actuals)}")

    return accuracy


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
